## History

Martin Crawford was engaged to [Clementine Ainslie](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) when she was a child. Eighteen years prior to recent events, he confessed his intense, youthful affection to [Clementine](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) during a spring twilight at a hidden spring in [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow). His life ended when his ship was wrecked at The Magdalens, resulting in the drowning of Crawford and the entire crew.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P66](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0066), [v5 CHAPTER XIII. THE HOUSE ON THE HILL P0](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0000)_
